summary: Check the marked fields before sending.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.hint: I’ll reply to the number you message me from. If it’s a different one, write it with the country code.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: I’ll reply to the address you write from, unless you give another.

errors.name: Write your name so I know who I’m talking to.
errors.details: Write at least one line about your business or idea.
errors.about: Write at least one line about yourself.
errors.email: Write a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.url: Write a full link starting with https://

preview.name: Nasser
preview.status: Reads your message and replies himself
preview.caption: This is your message as I’ll receive it.

join.subject: Collaboration request
join.hello: Hi Nasser, I’m {name}, and I’d like to work with you.

gaps.name: your name
gaps.details: your idea or problem, in two or three lines
gaps.about: your experience, and what you love working on

send.fine: This site keeps nothing you type: the message is written on your device and goes straight to WhatsApp or your email.

done.title: Your message is ready

ready.whatsapp: Your message is ready in WhatsApp
ready.email: Your message is ready in your email

done.text: Press “Send” there so your request reaches me, and I’ll reply via {channel}.
done.copied: Message copied. Paste it into a chat or an email to me.
done.copyFailed: I couldn’t copy it automatically. Use the other button to open your message again.
